text:
Alex: Morning — kicking off a small canary for fallback routing when host capacity is constrained. 5% traffic will go to quantized-x1 (q4_0) with KV warmup. Will monitor p95/p99 latency and error rate. :rocket:
Priya: SG. Which dashboards should we watch? I'll add the new series to the SLO tile.
Alex: Watch: /dashboards/slo/serving_latency and /dashboards/evictions/kv_hit. Also the 'fallback-failures' alert.
Jamie: Heads-up: I'm changing pager rotation for next 2 days to include Denise for daytime.
oncall-bot: @Denise added to next two rotations.
Denise: got it. Please ping me for CR review — I saw the routing PR in #prs, will take a look after standup.
Alex: Config snippet:
```
routes:
  - name: primary
    policy: capacity-first
  - name: fallback-quantized
    policy: fallback
    rollout: 5%
    model: quantized-x1
```
Priya: Can we debounce the fallback alert so it doesn't page on transient spikes? Maybe 3m window + 2 occurrences.
Jamie: +1. Also add a synthetic canary that hits the fallback path every 15m so we get health signals.
Denise: FYI I bumped the alert severity for 'eviction-rate' to P2 and lowered the threshold by 10% in infra-alerts PR.
Alex: Thanks. I'll watch the canary and post an update in ~30m. If p99 goes >500ms we'll auto-rollback the route.
Priya: :eyes: I'll update the SLO incident playbook with the rollback step and notify CS.
oncall-bot: Reminder — rotation change applied. Next oncall: Denise, Jamie, Alex.
Jamie: quick ask — @Denise when you review, could you also eyeball the KV warmup TTL? I set it to 60s but might need 120s.
Denise: will check. If we need longer, prefer 120s for steady traffic. :thumbsup:
Alex: Cool. Logging check: sending a short trace id on canary runs: `trace=fallback-canary-33579` — paste me any traces you see.
Priya: Thanks all — mark this async resolved unless anyone sees an issue. :white_check_mark:
